title: Cliopatria native-coordinate geometry assets — one geometry per gzip file
attribution: Historical territories: Cliopatria / Seshat Global History Databank (CC BY 4.0).

processing.numericSemantics: JSON parsed as binary64 numbers and serialized with round-trip-safe Python JSON; all parsed numeric values preserved exactly. Numeric lexical spelling/whitespace may differ from source.
processing.deduplication: SHA-256 of canonical complete geometry JSON followed by exact byte and object equality checks; ordered rings and components retained
processing.recordIdentity: clio-{source feature array index:05d}, verified against existing id/name/start/end/type
processing.sourceGeometryValidity: retained unchanged; invalid source geometries are not repaired

shardSizeTarget.note: The previous 250–600KB grouping target does not apply to independent geometry files.

limits: Native coordinates preserve source geometry fidelity; they do not establish greater historical accuracy, reconstruct unknown dates, or reconcile historical coastlines with a modern basemap.
